items.claim: Group CEO Johan Kirstein Brammer said "Tryg delivered the highest ever reported insurance service result supported by strong results in Sweden and Norway".
items.source: Johan Kirstein Brammer, Group CEO, Tryg A/S, in the Q1-Q3 2026 interim report

items.claim: Brammer said "I am pleased that customer satisfaction continued its positive momentum and reached a record-high level".
items.source: Johan Kirstein Brammer, Group CEO, Tryg A/S, in the Q1-Q3 2026 interim report

items.claim: Brammer said Tryg had "proudly announced three significant new motor partnerships with Mercedes-Benz in Sweden" and that "this creates further opportunities for profitable growth within the motor segment".
items.source: Johan Kirstein Brammer, Group CEO, Tryg A/S, in the Q1-Q3 2026 interim report

items.claim: Tryg announced, under section 30 of the Capital Markets Act, that BlackRock, Inc. had notified it of a reduction taking its total holding of shares and financial instruments with similar economic effect below 5% of Tryg's share capital and voting rights.
items.source: Tryg A/S major shareholder announcement, reporting a notification from BlackRock, Inc.

items.claim: Tryg announced that "today, 12 October 2026, Tryg shares are traded ex-dividend of DKK 2.15".
